description: From dynamic timelines, responsive swimlanes, and bar formatting, JVIZ Product Roadmap is quick to setup and easy to customize. Compare time series data across various project dimensions, epics, and features. Multi-year portfolio reporting has never been easier. Whether you are a project manager, event scheduler, SCRUM master, JVIZ Product Roadmap provides a professional view into your portfolio. Key Features include: ● 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺 𝗦𝘁𝘆𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴: Easy color picker and conditional formatting. ● 𝗠𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗩𝗶𝗲𝘄𝘀: Year, quarterly and monthly reporting. ● 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘇𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗦𝘄𝗶𝗺𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀: Adjust swimlane categories, size and style. ● 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗰𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲𝘁𝗲 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴: Quickly view work complete vs. remaining. ● 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗥𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲 𝗙𝗶𝗹𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴: Multiple ways to slice and dice your schedule. ● 𝗧𝗼𝗱𝗮𝘆 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿: Toggle the today line setting to stay ahead of schedule.
